/bin/sh -c "python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
connection = sqlite3.connect('inventory.db')
connection.execute('''
    CREATE TABLE products (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        quantity INTEGER NOT NULL
    )
''')
connection.commit()
connection.close()
PY"
